claim: flow_hash_computation.md's Data Shapes section (TreeBuilder → SnapshotStore, lines ~118-120) declares `node_type` a closed string enum — `component | requirement | data_flow | test_section | api | meta` — under a section stating that any change to a field there is a contract change requiring all three participants to update in lockstep.
authoritative_source: arch_tree_builder.md:32 says 'Which leaves exist is the resolved profile's declaration: TreeBuilder creates one leaf per node of each declared type', with no restriction that a profile-declared type's name must be one of the fixed five. test_hashing.md S11 ('A profile-declared type gets a leaf like any built-in type', lines ~126-130) accepts this at face value: it fixtures a profile declaring an `endpoint` type and asserts BuildTree emits a leaf for it, keyed and hashed like any built-in type — which necessarily carries `node_type: "endpoint"`, a value outside the flow doc's enum.
evidence: This PR's implementation (merkle/tree_builder.go) sets `NodeType: nt.Name` for every profile-declared type, so an arbitrary declared name flows straight into the `node_type` field — exactly what arch_tree_builder.md:32 and test_hashing.md S11 describe and assert. TestS11_BuildTree_ProfileDeclaredContentTypeGetsALeaf therefore asserts a leaf with `node_type: "endpoint"`, which flow_hash_computation.md's enum forbids. Before this PR the enum was true (only the five built-in types existed and could reach `node_type`); now two of this bead's own leaves — arch and test — license behavior a third — flow — declares impossible, and nothing in any of the three leaves says which one is stale. This is the implementer's own contract (all three leaves are cited as this bead's spec, per module.json), but the contradiction does not gate this task: the code below satisfies arch_tree_builder.md and test_hashing.md (both of which have concrete, matching tests in this bead), and flow_hash_computation.md's enum is not exercised by any test this bead owns. Filed non-blocking so the code stands as arch/test currently specify it, pending the authoring loop's decision on which of the two positions (open node_type vocabulary vs. closed enum) is correct.
proposed_fix: Either (a) widen flow_hash_computation.md's `node_type` enum to 'the closed default set, extensible per-profile with any name a resolved profile declares' so it stops contradicting arch_tree_builder.md:32 and test_hashing.md S11, or (b) narrow arch_tree_builder.md:32 and drop/rewrite test_hashing.md S11 so a profile-declared type is restricted to reusing one of the six fixed node_type values (and is composed differently, e.g. via `NameDeclarable` semantics) rather than minting a new node_type string.
